projects.title: San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing (N64) Static Recompilation
projects.status: The maintainer README labels the project Phase 3 (build system and runtime scaffold). It reports that 1,014 functions have been statically recompiled into 356,001 lines of C, but the build is not yet wired through the N64ModernRuntime/RT64 runtime; booting to a title screen, gameplay and audio remain future phases. No GitHub release was listed on 2026-10-16. The README requires a user-supplied legally obtained ROM. These are repository status claims, not a playable-build claim.
projects.summary: A static recompilation of the Nintendo 64 version of San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing. The README says it uses N64Recomp to translate MIPS machine code into C/C++, paired with N64ModernRuntime, RT64 and an SDL2 scaffold. The code-generation milestone is reported complete, while runtime wiring and boot/render/gameplay are still outstanding. No ROM or game data is included.
projects.strategy: Static recompilation of the N64 MIPS executable through N64Recomp into C/C++, followed by planned native runtime integration with N64ModernRuntime and RT64.
projects.source_available: Public repository. LICENSE grants MIT terms for repository tools, runtime, build files and documentation only; it expressly excludes original game code/assets and generated code derived from the game. No ROM or game assets are included; users must supply their own legally obtained ROM.

projects.title: Aliens versus Predator Gold (NakedAVP SDL3 Source Port)
projects.platform: Aliens versus Predator Gold → Linux, macOS and Windows (SDL3)
projects.status: The latest maintainer release is 1.3.1, published 2026-10-16. The README identifies this as an unofficial Linux and Mac OS X port and says the current code also works on Windows. The release notes list mouse fixes, rendering/performance changes, resolution fixes, shader rewrites, dynamic lighting, and bloom/lite-HDR. The README says some original features, including multiplayer, remain missing. It requires user-provided original game data; this status does not establish compatibility with every store build or system.
projects.summary: A modern SDL3 source port of Aliens versus Predator Gold based on the icculus port. The maintainer README lists Linux/macOS/Windows support, with CMake, SDL3, OpenAL, OpenGL and FFmpeg dependencies. The repository distributes source but not the game data. This is a source port/reimplementation, not a static recompilation or an API-translation layer.
projects.strategy: Cross-platform source port based on the icculus AvP port, with SDL3 and modern rendering/audio dependencies.
projects.source_available: Public source repository. Its LICENSE states that original Aliens vs Predator source is copyright Rebellion (1999–2000), prohibits commercial use, and requires visible credit and restatement of the license; later changes are also stated to be noncommercial. GitHub reports NOASSERTION for the repository license. The README says users must obtain original game data separately from GOG, Steam or CD; no game data is bundled.
